situation: Development tests and an architecture record were stored inside a distributable skill directory.
attempted_behavior: Moved both categories out after discussing test packaging, without first reviewing whether the architecture record contained runtime requirements.
feedback: Move development-only tests out, but review design documentation before relocating it and preserve any information the runtime skill needs.
corrected_behavior: Separated tests and maintainer documentation from the skill, reviewed the architecture record, and retained its storage-layout and no-op initialization requirements in the runtime decision policy.
outcome: Repository tests, official validators, and an isolated skill installation passed with only runtime resources distributed.
